summary.text: Lamar Wise is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 48 who was appointed to the seat in November 2025 and is seeking election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Ballotpedia lists him with Democratic, Working Families Party and Independent Party of Oregon nominations.

paragraphs.text: Lamar Wise's career experience includes working as a nonprofit executive director.
He was appointed to Oregon House District 48 on November 5, 2025, to replace Hoa Nguyen, and assumed office on November 14, 2025.
